outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted tactical fantasy battle animation sheet. Upper left trailing ribbon suspends a small purple lantern; upper right ribbon suspends ivory scroll with dark seal. Preserve book, staff, lantern, scroll, crown and ribbon attachments. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard painted in, no scenery/floor/grid/text.
